summary: Initial verified seed dataset created.
Promoted 18 new stores and 32 recurring Commander events from the Wizards locator snapshot; 68 organizations remain in the review report.
Promoted 2 additional stores and 4 recurring Commander events from repeated Wizards listings in the 15–26 mile discovery ring.
Added the first attributed user field note source capturing Finch and Sparrow visit observations for Saturday structured Commander and Sunday open play.

Promoted confirmed top-tranche findings into normalized data for Finch, Collectors Lounge, Kingslayer Fountain Valley, and The Guild House, including Guild House Tuesday Commander and stronger official-source routing.
Promoted follow-on venue interpretation for ProjectCCG, Spellhold, and Krazy Nick's, especially schedule ambiguity, open-play characterization, and community-fit notes from Discord evidence.
Promoted Collector Legion Discord-backed community and solo-arrival interpretation into the normalized store record while keeping Saturday Commander unofficial pending stronger source support.

Completed a comparable public-source pass for Collector Legion, adding official-site source routing, Instagram/X profile evidence, and an explicit Saturday displacement-risk interpretation while keeping only Tuesday Commander fully confirmed.
Completed a focused source-routing pass for Collectors Lounge, confirming that no cleaner event-commerce layer surfaced beyond the canonical Discord plus Instagram plus Wizards weekly trio.

Completed the deferred deeper social pass for The Guild House, Kingslayer Fountain Valley, and Collector Legion, clarifying where socials are operationally strong, branch-mixed, or only partially specific for Commander research.

Refined The Guild House interpretation by distinguishing useful reservation tooling from true solo-arrival support and by recording that proxy policy remains unstated in the reviewed official/public sources.

Refined Kingslayer Fountain Valley interpretation by translating `Slay Pass` into plain-language structured Commander event meaning while keeping booster-pack support only as a branch-ambiguous Kingslayer-branded clue.
Added an attributed user preference note that Kingslayer Fountain Valley should remain the primary weighted branch, Lake Forest stays worth watching, and Oceanside is out of scope due to distance.

Promoted earlier Finch routine-Commander findings plus the attributed user field note into normalized data so routine Thursday/Saturday Commander, structured Saturday pod behavior, and the separate Birdcage/Fish Bowl/cEDH promotional layer are more clearly distinguished.

Refined the project modeling rules so explicit Commander open-play listings are treated as a distinct event type rather than collapsed into generic Commander ambiguity, with Finch Sunday open play as the motivating example.
Refined the displacement-risk rule so a prominently advertised same-day major event such as an RCQ can be enough to mark routine Commander as at risk even without an explicit cancellation notice.

Refined Collectors Lounge interpretation so Friday casual Commander is clearly treated as a strong Bracket 3/proxy-friendly fit while solo-arrival confidence remains only medium until explicit pod-assignment or LFG support is found.

Promoted a light nearby-store tranche from Wizards-led evidence, especially Honey Pot Meadery as a strong open-play/nontraditional lead and SoCalMagic as an explicit no-proxy caution case, while keeping Hobby Overflow, Joyful Toad, and Requiem in the promising-but-lightly-vetted set.

Completed the first comparable social and official-source pass for Honey Pot Meadery, Hobby Overflow, and Joyful Toad TCG, promoting Hobby Overflow and Joyful Toad to partial status and materially strengthening Honey Pot as a secondary fit candidate.

Expanded the standing methodology to treat WPN/Wizards news as an upstream event-vocabulary signal layer and added a daily light-sweep model for socials, alerts, cancellations, and urgent event changes that can eventually power a daily dashboard.
Clarified in the standing project docs that user favorites are a first-class watchlist and should automatically enter the daily monitoring tier with higher alert priority.

Completed a dedicated Requiem pass, confirming a socially active venue with real Commander identity but explicitly collaboration-sensitive schedule reliability more akin to a flexible venue calendar than a rigid weekly store series.
Added MTG-focus as a distinct analytical dimension so Magic-centered stores can be differentiated from broader mixed-use venues where Commander is only one part of the programming mix.

Added a standing calibration note that MTG-focus, player-pool breadth, venue-scale, and play-space-image evidence should be backfilled cautiously and revisited if they produce weird or unhelpful rankings.

Promoted Honey Pot Meadery's richer official event stream into normalized records, including the God of Mischief Commander variant, structured Mead & Mana Commander League items, and a Hobbit prerelease.

Deepened Honey Pot interpretation with secondary signals, concluding that it has meaningful player-pool breadth and active social energy but only medium MTG-focus because Magic shares the venue with broader fandom and community programming.

Promoted Honey Pot Meadery's official events calendar into the daily-refresh source set because its regularly updated Magic formats and variants indicate serious event curation and community-building effort.

Confirmed that Hobby Overflow's Discord path is real and nontrivial, strengthening the store's breadth/opportunity profile even though deeper Commander-specific Discord interpretation remains pending.

Completed a fuller Joyful Toad pass that adds scale and prominence signals, concluding that the store looks broad and active with decent opportunity surface but still not strongly Commander-centered in the current public evidence.
